6-2-25
Claimant reported a left-turn collision at an intersection and stated a knee injury from the impact; the claim was
opened and the file assigned for review.
6-4-25
Reviewed the police report and spoke with the other driver, who described the collision the same way the claimant
did; the driver is named on the policy and the coverage was in force at the time.
6-27-25
Two independent witnesses and scene photographs match the described sequence, and the police report confirms
the claimant was in the vehicle when it happened.
10-3-25
Vehicle damage was inspected and is consistent with the reported impact; no prior damage to the vehicle is known,
and nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the policy start.
11-20-25
Claimant's account has stayed the same across every call and written statement, with no changes in the details of the
turn or the impact.
12-30-25
Medical records show the knee injury fits the kind and force of the crash, and no earlier injury to that body area is
known from the claimant's history or prior records.
1-14-26
Treatment followed a usual course and tapered as the claimant improved; the file is being prepared for the inujry
evaluation with no open questions on causation.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
